feeds.title: Biathlon Integrity Unit Blog
feeds.description: The Biathlon Integrity Unit is an operationally independent and specialized unit of the International Biathlon Union. The Biathlon Integrity Unit handles all integrity-related matters in Biathlon, including anti-doping, ethical breaches, betting-related issues, and any kind of result manipulation.

feeds.title: Biathlon23
feeds.description: This biathlon blog is written by a biathlon fan for biathlon fans. Enjoy the biathlete interviews from all levels in the biathlon - World Cup, IBU Cup, Junior Cup, and para-biathlon. You can also find news, views, and race reviews!

feeds.title: Clare Egan Blog
feeds.description: Clare Egan is a biathlete and cross-country skier originally from Cape Elizabeth, Maine. She started cross-country skiing in middle school and went on to become a Maine state champion and two-time member of the New England Junior National team.
